[size=4]Instalation[/size]

1. To install, navigate to you Stardew Valley "Content" folder ([i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content[/i])

2. Open the downloaded zip file ([i]Linus To Asriel[/i]). In that file you will see two folders, "[i]Into Characters[/i]" and "[i]Into Portraits[/i]"

3. Locate the Characters folder in your Stardew Valley Content folder.

4. Open the "[i]Into Characters[/i]" folder and drag Linus.xnb into the Stardew Valley Content/Characters file(C:\Program Files       (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters). It will ask you if you would like to replace files, click replace.

5. Repeat step 5 for the "[i]Into Portraits[/i]" folder(Make sure to use [i]C:\Program Files(x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits [/i][b]NOT [/b][i]C:\Program Files(x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters[/i]).

[size=2]6. Launch Game![/size]
